svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.12.2.2 Minimum Depth of Foundations
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.12.2.2 Minimum Depth of Foundations
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.12 EXCAVATION
Minimum Depth of Foundations

g.text: Heated crawl space in clay: 1.2 m
No heated space (a garage): 1.2 m but
not less than the depth of frost penetration
to the soil beneath the footings
Interior insulation, wall and under slab:
reduces it, depth as for no heated space
1 and 2 risers: permitted to be laid
Not more than 1 storey and 55 m²
ground to the underside of the joists
Decking that lifts out: access to the
(1) Foundation not insulated to reduce heat loss through the footings.
(2) Including foundations insulated to reduce heat loss through the footings.
(3) Good soil drainage to not less than the depth of frost penetration.
(4) See Note A-Table 9.12.2.2.: intended for soils subject to significant volume changes

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as in Sentences (4) to (7), the minimum depth of foundations
below finished ground level conforms to Table 9.12.2.2.
A foundation insulated in a manner that reduces heat flow to the
soil beneath the footings takes the depth for foundations
containing no heated space
Exterior concrete steps with more than 2 risers: foundation depth
to Sentences (1), (2) and (5). Steps with 1 and 2 risers are
permitted to be laid on ground level
The depths may be decreased where experience with local soil
conditions shows lesser depths are satisfactory, or where the
foundation is designed for lesser depths
The depths required by Sentence (1) do not apply to buildings not
of masonry or masonry veneer construction whose superstructure
conforms to the deformation resistance test in CSA Z240.2.1, or to
accessory buildings
Accessory buildings not of masonry or masonry veneer, not more than 1
storey, not more than 55 m² (592 ft²) in building area, and not more than
600 mm (23⅝″) from finished ground to the underside of the floor joists.
Nor to decks and other accessible exterior platforms of not more
than 1 storey and 55 m², not more than 600 mm to the underside of
the joists, not supporting a roof
And not attached to another structure, unless it can be demonstrated that
differential movement will not adversely affect the performance of that
structure.
Platforms on surface foundations on other than coarse-grained soil
with good drainage or rock: access to the foundation positions to
permit re-levelling
By passageways with a clear height under the platform of not less than
600 mm and a width of not less than 600 mm, or by installing the decking
in a manner that allows easy removal.
A: clay soil, one row of the table. B redrawn from Figure A-9.12.2.2.(2). Step foundation form and all sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.12.2.2. (page 9-106)
